**What changed**
- `src/duration.ts` — `parseDuration` validates the whole string against `<number><unit>` parts (units `ms|d|h|m|s`, so `ms` wins over `m`), allows fractions and runs of whitespace between parts, trims outer space, sums in ms and rounds; errors quote the input. `formatDuration` walks d/h/m/s/ms largest-first, omits zero parts, returns `"0s"` for 0, and throws on negative/non-finite input.
- `src/slug.ts` — lowercases, expands ß/æ/œ/ø/ł/đ, strips diacritics via NFD + combining-mark removal, maps all remaining non-`[a-z0-9]` runs to a single `-`, trims leading/trailing dashes, then applies `max`: keeps exactly `max` when `slug[max] === '-'`, else cuts at the last dash within the limit, else at `max`. `uniqueSlug` returns the slug or the first free `-2`, `-3`, … suffix (checking `taken` from 2 upward).
- `src/lru.ts` — a `Map` in least→most-recently-used order with `{value, expiresAt}` entries. `get` moves hits to the MRU end and evicts/reports expired entries; `set` refreshes the ttl and, on overflow, first purges all expired entries then evicts the LRU live entry with `'capacity'` until within capacity; `delete` returns `false` for expired/missing (expired still reported); `size`/`keys()` report only live entries, keys MRU-first, and don't mutate.

## Report

Implemented all three independent modules in `src/`:

- **`src/duration.ts`** — `parseDuration` scans `<number><unit>` parts (`d`, `h`, `m`, `s`, `ms`, with `ms` matched before `m`), allows fractional numbers and optional whitespace between parts, trims the ends, sums to milliseconds and rounds; any gap, missing unit, sign, or empty input throws with the original text quoted. `formatDuration` splits into `d`/`h`/`m`/`s`/`ms`, omits zero parts, returns `"0s"` for zero and throws on negative/non-finite input.
- **`src/slug.ts`** — `slugify` lowercases, strips diacritics via NFD + combining-mark removal, expands `ß æ œ ø ł đ`, collapses every non-`[a-z0-9]` run to `-`, trims edge dashes, and truncates at the last dash at or before `max` (or hard at `max`). `uniqueSlug` walks `slug-2`, `slug-3`, … to the first free name.
- **`src/lru.ts`** — Map-ordered LRU with expiry; `get` promotes hits and drops expired entries with `'expired'`, `set` refreshes TTL/position and, on overflow, purges all expired entries before evicting live LRU entries with `'capacity'`, `delete` distinguishes live (`true`, `'delete'`) from expired (`false`, `'expired'`), and `size`/`keys()` report only live entries with `keys()` most-recent-first.

**Tests:** the permission guard blocked editing the existing test files (`test/*.test.ts`) and directed me to create a new test file, so the extra coverage is in `test/extra-rules.test.ts` (duration malformed inputs/fractions/round-trip, slug diacritics/specials/truncation/`uniqueSlug`, and LRU expiry boundaries, callback reasons, capacity-vs-expiry purge order, delete semantics, overwrite TTL refresh). The original tests are untouched.

Not checked: there is no TypeScript compiler or `package.json` in the repo, so I ran only `bun test`, not a type check.
